plugin: Favor Quests Seperated.esp (its own record; no later plugin edits it in these files)
canDoWhy: A dragon bounty for Whiterun Hold; the game picks the dragon's lair when the bounty is handed out.
firstStep: Kill the dragon at the place the bounty names

takesYou.place: the dragon's lair named in the bounty (picked by the game)
Dragonsreach in Whiterun
takesYou.why: collect the bounty from the steward or the jarl

objectives: Kill the dragon located at the bounty's location
Collect bounty from the steward (or from the jarl)

people.name: the steward of Whiterun Hold
people.role: pays the bounty (filled by the game, not named in the records)

people.name: the jarl of Whiterun Hold
people.role: pays the bounty if there is no steward to collect from (filled by the game)

unsure.why: This copy of the bounty, made just for Whiterun Hold, has roles for an innkeeper, a bounty letter, the jarl and the steward, but these files show no dialogue line or event that hands it out. Most likely an innkeeper, the steward or the jarl gives it, or a letter does, but the records here don't say which.

The steward and the jarl are filled in when the quest runs and can change (for example after the war). The records place the people of the jarl's court (Balgruuf the Greater and Proventus Avenicci) in Dragonsreach.
The dragon's lair is chosen when the quest starts; there's no fixed place in the records.
The game's own dragon bounty also hands out a Requiem reward list, but this hold copy only lists gold. The amount is set in the quest script and isn't in these files.
The mod copies the game's dragon bounty into one quest per hold. These files don't show whether the game's own version is still switched on as well.
